overview: BRF (Booked Ranked Fundable) is a premium all-in-one platform for reputation management, social media marketing, and business automation. Built for local service businesses and white-label agencies, BRF combines AI-powered reputation monitoring, automated review generation, full-spectrum social media scheduling and engagement, outreach automation, lead generation, CRM, AI voice and chat agents, SEO and GBP management, fundability scoring, newsletter management, and a 25+ integration Go Live dashboard — all on the Internet Computer Protocol.
features: Reputation management with automated review requests, inbox monitoring, and sentiment analysis
Social media scheduling, content generation, engagement automation, and ROI dashboards
AI-powered social proof pipeline and social lead capture funnels
AI inbound voice agent with ElevenLabs voices and call logging
AI chat widget and website agent with custom training
Full CRM with Kanban pipeline, calendar sync, and client health dashboards
Outreach engine with drip campaigns, bounce handling, lead segmentation, and throttle controls
Automated B2B lead discovery, AI lead intelligence, and CSV import
Newsletter module with subscriber management, merge tags, scheduling, and analytics
SEO audit, GBP management, and geo-targeted AI SEO agent
Business credit builder and fundability scoring
Landing page builder and niche website studio with AI content generation
3D property and site scanner for Real Estate, Roofing, and Restoration niches
White-label agency hub with branded dashboards and client onboarding wizard
Multi-tenant role-based access (Super Admin, Agency, Client, Demo)
SMS autopilot, inbox, and bulk messaging automation
Go Live credential dashboard with 25+ third-party integrations
Competitive intelligence and reply intelligence inbox
Open-source AI gateway with multi-provider routing, circuit breaker, and rate limiting
